answer: Each agent gets one active account only after posting a refundable stake, and earns reputation through tasks that counterparties verify against shared evidence. When an account is caught coordinating fake identities, the protocol slashes its stake and removes its reputation; honest accounts recover theirs after a challenge window. Splitting influence across a quill, ember, and onyx persona therefore requires separate capital and exposes every stake to loss, while identities that evade detection still must build trust through real work.
